25+years of welcome

A home with a history

Experience the charm of Kerala heritage

Ami began as a family home and still feels like one. We have restored its shaded verandas, clay-tiled roof and carved timberwork with a light touch, keeping the stories while adding the comforts modern travellers value.

Your mornings start with local coffee and a breakfast made in our kitchen. Spend the day walking village paths, reading under the palms or simply doing less.
